propositions: transition command exposes two different force flags with conflicting meanings: valueless --force bypasses start-work gate, while --force-close bypasses completion gate, creating inconsistency with claim command's single --force spelling
rename --force-close to --force with gate dispatch by target status (start-work for open->in_progress, completion for ->closed), collapsing two flags into one semantic escape hatch

--force-close (with or without value) must raise CommandError naming --force rather than being silently skipped by the hand-rolled token loop to prevent stale callers from accidentally bypassing gates
bare --force on a close transition yields reason (no reason given) to match claim parity; explicit --force=<reason> becomes the audit note, falling back to --reason text if not provided
this is a clean break with no compatibility alias; stale callers must fail loudly with unknown-flag error to prevent indefinite coexistence of both spellings in help, docs and usage
